title: RetailPulse Inventory (synthetic snapshot)
description: Current synthetic inventory snapshot. Values use current catalog price and current primary-supplier cost; the time picker does not apply.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(on_hand), 0) AS value FROM reporting.inventory_snapshot WHERE ('$location' = 'All' OR location_code = '$location') AND ('$category' = 'All' OR category = '$category')
SELECT coalesce(sum(available), 0) AS value FROM reporting.inventory_snapshot WHERE ('$location' = 'All' OR location_code = '$location') AND ('$category' = 'All' OR category = '$category')
SELECT coalesce(sum(cost_value), 0) AS value FROM reporting.inventory_snapshot WHERE ('$location' = 'All' OR location_code = '$location') AND ('$category' = 'All' OR category = '$category')

panels.title: Out-of-stock product locations
panels.description: Current rows with zero available units; this is not the Control Tower's forecast-risk measure.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE available = 0) AS value FROM reporting.inventory_snapshot WHERE ('$location' = 'All' OR location_code = '$location') AND ('$category' = 'All' OR category = '$category')

SELECT location_code AS "Location", sum(available)::integer AS "Available", sum(reserved)::integer AS "Reserved" FROM reporting.inventory_snapshot WHERE ('$location' = 'All' OR location_code = '$location') AND ('$category' = 'All' OR category = '$category') GROUP BY location_code ORDER BY location_code

panels.title: Lowest available stock
panels.description: Current quantities only; use the Control Tower for forecast-based risk.

targets.rawSql: SELECT location_code AS "Location", sku AS "SKU", product_name AS "Product", on_hand AS "On hand", reserved AS "Reserved", available AS "Available" FROM reporting.inventory_snapshot WHERE ('$location' = 'All' OR location_code = '$location') AND ('$category' = 'All' OR category = '$category') ORDER BY available, on_hand, sku LIMIT 20

list.name: location
list.label: Location
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT location_code AS __text, location_code AS __value FROM reporting.inventory_snapshot ORDER BY 1

list.name: category
list.label: Category
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT category AS __text, category AS __value FROM reporting.inventory_snapshot ORDER BY 1
